tasks.title: Add the pure judging function and the band constants
tasks.dod: Boundary table tests for human, ordinary AI and known-gap AI samples pass, and a known-gap flag never turns a failed verdict into a passed one.

tasks.title: Discover and classify the items of the sample folder
tasks.dod: Unit tests show every folder item is classified, unclassified or ignored, per-category counts plus ignored equal the folder total, and missing categories are named.

tasks.title: Read and validate the known-gap list, seed it with the first entry
tasks.dod: Unit tests show a known-gap entry flags an AI sample only, while an entry naming a human or a missing sample is an eval.bad_known_gap error, and evals/known-gaps.txt holds the seeded line.

tasks.title: Analyse one sample in a fresh process and fail closed
tasks.dod: Fake-analyzer tests show a crash, a hang past the limit, an empty, unreadable or incomplete result and an out-of-range index each end as an analyzer failure with a reason, never as an index.

tasks.title: Build the report, the evidence summary and the outcome decision
tasks.dod: Report tests against a fake analyzer show all contract facts appear, notes alone give a passed run, any failure kind gives a failed run, and two reports of the same inputs differ only in the duration line.

tasks.title: Add the CLI entry point, detector copy lookup and exit code
tasks.dod: Tests show the header names the chosen plugin (ukr-text-guard by default), a missing copy exits 1, a bad option exits 1, a forced exception exits 1, and no path returns a code other than 0 or 1.

tasks.title: Make run.sh a thin delegate that finds a working Python
tasks.dod: In Git Bash, bash evals/run.sh prints the report and returns the runner's exit code (0 on the real folder or a passing run, 1 with --plugin ukr-text-unknown).

tasks.title: Prove independence and repeatability on the real analyzer
tasks.dod: The unit test suite passes with a test that gives equal verdicts for every real sample alone, together and in reverse order, and two real-folder reports equal apart from the duration line.

tasks.title: Verify the first real run on both shells and update the docs
tasks.dod: Verdict lines of the real run in PowerShell and in Git Bash are identical, the run takes at most 60 s, and docs/architecture-map.md and CONTEXT.md describe the new check and terms.
